ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the waterfront slope $AB$ of the dam cross-section has a slope ratio of $1\colon \sqrt{3}$. If the dam height $BC$ is 4m, what is the length of $AC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} According to the given information, we have $\frac{BC}{AC}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$,\\
$\therefore$ $\frac{4}{AC}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$,\\
Solving this, we get: $AC=\boxed{4\sqrt{3}}$m.
